messages:
jamie_rls: Planning a small micro-bump tonight to push the new routing layer. Target start 22:00 PST. Canary plan: 1% for 15m, then 5% for 20m, then 10% if healthy. Who's owning the smoke checks and rollback? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

elena_dev: I can run the functional smoke and sanity prompts. Can you confirm which model variant + quantization we're shipping?

jamie_rls: Shipping v2.3.1-quant8 with the fallback to v2.3.0 if errors spike. Config: `route_policy: geo-aware`, `cache_ttl: 30s`.

tom_sre: I'll take runtime / infra smoke and watch tailing logs + host metrics. I'll run the canary watcher and trigger rollback if p50 latency > 200ms or error-rate > 0.8% for two consecutive minutes.

rachel_oncall: Added runbook link in thread: https://confluence.redwood/infra/microbump-runbook. Oncall steps include `disable-feature-flag`, `scale-down-pool`, and `manual-rollback` commands.

chris_sre: Cohort selection: start with 1% mobile web US-EAST (low burst), then expand to 5% mobile web + desktop EU-WEST, final 10% includes APAC but only after metric pass. Avoid VIP customers and enterprise orgs (they're on dedicated).

elena_dev: Smoke checklist (short):
- sanity prompt: `echo "healthcheck" | ./client --model v2.3.1`
- sample QA prompts (10 tokens each) run through `smoke/run_smoke.sh --batch small`
- validate embeddings index warm-up for top-100 queries
- ensure KV cache hits > 70% on prefix runs

jamie_rls: rollback plan: primary = toggle FF `release/microbump-v2` off, fallback = route to v2.3.0, tertiary = scale to previous pool. Rollback command (ops):
```
deployctl rollback --service routing --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "auto-roll" --force
```

tom_sre: I'll be on pager during the window and will post updates every 5m in #eng-platform. I'll also watch Prometheus alert `canary_error_rate` and SLO dashboards.

chris_sre: Small note: adjust autoscaler min for canary nodes to avoid noisy autoscaling during the 1% stage: set `min_replicas=2` for canary pools. I'll apply a short override at T-5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by jamie_rls at 2025-03-10T22:00:00Z for service=router, tag=v2.3.1-quant8 -> state=scheduled :rocket:

rachel_oncall: Confirmed from PM: no marketing traffic tonight. Proceed if all owners ack.

elena_dev: ack for dev smoke (I'll post pass/fail within 5m of start).

tom_sre: ack for infra smoke + rollback ready.

jamie_rls: thanks everyone — I'll kick at 22:00. Ping here if you spot anything unexpected and we'll abort. :white_check_mark:
